label: AI Insight UI — KPI Broadcast
info:
Scheduled FAP §9 event broadcast of gold-layer Trino KPI aggregates.

Fires every 60s (after a 10s startup delay), fetches a Keycloak token, runs the kpi-summary SQL against gold.net_grid_hourly, builds an EventEnvelope { type:'event', event:'kpi.update', data:{netGrid,pvGeneration,dailyCost} }, and broadcasts to every connected UIBUILDER client via link-broadcast → dispatcher's link-from-broadcast → merge-session-send (no _socketId = fan-out). Replaces the legacy msg.data.topic = 'kpi.update' emission that previously rode along with on-demand trino.query responses (removed from format-trino-result on 2026-05-05).

Trino / Keycloak failures are swallowed by the catch node; they log a warning and skip the cycle so a single outage does not stop the schedule.

name: Prepare Keycloak Auth
Execute kpi-summary SQL
Collect Trino pages
Build kpi.update EventEnvelope
log + skip cycle
